statement: If a cube number by multiplying a cube number make some number, the product will be cube.
heath_proof: For let the cube number A by multiplying the cube number B make C; I say that C is cube. For let A by multiplying itself make D; therefore D is cube. [IX. 3] And, since A by multiplying itself has made D, and by multiplying B has made C therefore, as A is to B, so is D to C. [VII. 17] And, since A, B are cube numbers, A, B are similar solid numbers. Therefore two mean proportional numbers fall between A, B; [VIII. 19] so that two mean proportional numbers will fall between D, C also. [VIII. 8] And D is cube; therefore C is also cube [VIII. 23]
ai_proof_text:
9.4
**Statement:** If a cube number by multiplying a cube number make some number, the product will be cube.

**Step 1.** Let A be a cube number, let B be a cube number, and let A by multiplying B make C. I say that C is cube.

**Step 2.** Let A by multiplying itself make D. Since A is a cube number and, by multiplying itself, has made D, the product D is cube. [9.3]

**Step 3.** Since the one number A, by multiplying the two numbers A and B, has made D and C respectively, the numbers so produced have the same ratio as the numbers multiplied; therefore, as A is to B, so is D to C. [7.17]

**Step 4.** Now A and B are both cube numbers; therefore the ratio of A to B is the ratio which a cube number has to a cube number. And D has to C the same ratio that A has to B (Step 3); therefore D and C have to one another the ratio which a cube number has to a cube number.

**Step 5.** But the first of them, D, is cube (Step 2). Therefore the second, C, is also cube. [8.25]

**Step 6.** Therefore, if a cube number by multiplying a cube number make some number, the product will be cube. Q.E.D.

**Path note.** An equivalent but longer route exists: since A and B are cubes, each is contained by three equal numbers (D7.19), so their sides are proportional and they are similar solid numbers (D7.17, D7.21); hence two mean proportional numbers fall between A and B (8.19), hence also between D and C, which have the same ratio (8.8); and since D is cube, C is cube (8.23). The route through 8.25 was chosen as the most direct: once A : B = D : C is established, 8.25 is precisely the tool that converts "same ratio as a cube to a cube, first term cube" into "second term cube", whereas the longer route reconstructs the proof of 8.25 in place.
